div.head: II As 20.8
div.ab: Gif he ðonne oþwinde, ⁊ hwa hine feormige, sy his weres scyldig, butan he hine ladian durre be ðæs flyman were, þæt he hine flymene nyste.
Gif he ætwinde, ⁊ hine hwa feormige, sy he his weres scyldig, buton he hine ladian durre be þæs flyman were, þæt he hine flyman nyste.
… inde, ⁊ hine hwa feormige, sie he …, ..n he hine ladian durre be þæs …, .. flemne nyste.
Si aufugerit, et eum aliquis (interim) firmauerit, were sue sit reus, nisi se possit idoneare secundum ipsius profugi weram, quod eum nesciebat flyman (id est fugitiuum) esse.
Gif he ætwinde, ⁊ hine hwa feormige, sy he his weres scyldig, buton he hine ladian durre be þæs flyman were, þæt he hine flyman nyste.

If he escapes and anyone harbours him, he [who does so] shall forfeit his wergeld unless he dares to clear himself by [declaring an oath equal to] the fugitive's wergeld, that he did not know he was a fugitive.
If he escapes, and anyone harbours him, he is to be liable to pay his wergild, unless he dares to clear himself by the [amount of the] fugitive’s wergild, that he did not know that he was a fugitive.

Wenn er (aber Ld) entflieht, und ihn jemand beherbergt, sei dieser das Wergeld jenes schuldig, ausser wenn er sich mit [Eid in Höhe vom] Wergeld des Geächteten rein zu schwören wagt, dass er ihn nicht als Geächteten kannte.

If (however, Ld) he escapes, and someone harbours him, let that person be liable for his wergild, unless he dares to clear himself with [an oath to the amount of] the outlaw's wergild that he did not know him to be an outlaw.
